goal: Bring the deterministic build environment up to date with upstream Guix package definitions
Make newer compiler toolchains available for release builds and remove obsolete package workarounds
agreement: Verified by building and matching output hashes on x86_64 (0xB10C, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on riscv64 with an unbound variable error (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on aarch64 hosts due to missing system headers (janb84, hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: codesign manifest fails from missing python-setuptools dependency (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it modernizes release build infrastructure without fixing an active release breakage
Enables newer compilers and cleans up package definitions for release builds
